context.p: After editing your audio, you need to export it to a standard audio format for sharing or playback. Audacity project files (.aup3) can only be opened by Audacity, so you must export to formats like MP3 or WAV.

step.cmd:
Choose
File Export Export as MP3 .
In the export dialog, choose a location and filename for your file.
Set the Bit Rate Mode to Constant and the Quality to 192 kbps for a good balance of quality and file size.

note.p: For podcasts, 128 kbps mono is usually sufficient and produces smaller files. For music, use 256 kbps or higher.

step.cmd: Fill in the metadata tags (Title, Artist, Album) if desired, then click OK.

result.p: Your audio is now saved as an MP3 file that can be played on any device or uploaded to the web.

note.p:
To export as WAV instead (for lossless quality), choose
File Export Export as WAV .
